title: Don’t book anyone else - Such an amazing experience!
text: After meeting Leonardo for the photo walking tour in Barcelona that was amazing, I hired him for photos and OMG wow. He is such a kind and lovely person I felt super comfortable and not awkward at all. He took beautiful photos and helped me to pose and feel good. I am usually skeptical about male photographers but he is insanely talented and such a professional and nice person that I can 1000% recommend to work with him. If you want couple photos, the best guide in town or cute shots for your instagram, he will completely over deliver. I can’t wait to book another private session with him next

title: Memorable experience
text:
Our photo session in Sitges was absolutely wonderful. The entire experience felt genuine, natural, and effortless, which made the photos turn out beautifully. We were able to  capture real moments and emotions rather than forced poses, creating memories I will cherish forever.
The stunning scenery of Sitges combined with the relaxed atmosphere made the session even more special. Every photo reflects the beauty of the location and the authenticity of the experience.
If you're visiting Sitges, this is a must-do activity for anyone wanting to capture special memories. Highly recommended!

title: Thank you Charlotte!
text:
We had the most amazing couple photoshoot experience in Sitges. From the start, Charlotte made us feel completely comfortable and at ease in front of the camera.

The setting in Sitges was absolutely stunning, the charming streets, the Mediterranean views, and the golden sunset light made everything feel so romantic. Charlotte knew exactly how to use the beautiful scenery of Catalonia to create timeless and elegant images.

What we loved most was how natural the session felt. Nothing was forced, just genuine moments, laughter, and connection. The photos truly reflect who we are as a couple.

title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The Highlight of My Sitges Trip
text:
If you’re nervous about being in front of the camera, book Charlotte. I’m a total beginner and usually feel awkward in photos, but Charlotte made me feel instantly comfortable and confident. She is incredibly warm and puts you at ease immediately. 
It felt more like a fun walk through Sitges with a friend than a formal shoot.

She gives perfect, natural direction—no modeling experience required!

She knows the most stunning, quiet backstreets and coastal views.

The photos turned out breathtaking and are my favorite souvenirs from Spain. 
Do not hesitate—Charlotte is the best.
author: Charlotte W
